Mathematical_Formulation: div(2 H_ice nu (2 eps_dot + tr(eps_dot) I)) - beta_b u = rho_i g H_ice grad(s_ice)
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: u = (u,v) [m/s] depth-averaged velocity; H_ice [m] solid ice thickness; s_ice [m] surface; nu [Pa s] effective viscosity; beta_b [Pa s/m] basal drag; rho_i=917 kg/m^3; g=9.81 m/s^2
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid for fast sliding, streaming, and floating ice where vertical shear is negligible compared to horizontal membrane stresses (aspect ratio eps = [H]/[L] << 1)
Boundary_Condition_Application: Applies across entire active 2D ice domain (grounded ice M=2 and floating ice M=3)
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Finite Volume / Bilinear Finite Element on staggered 500 m quadrilateral grid
Physical_Approximation_Classification: Mathematical Derivation (Depth-integrated asymptotic expansion of Stokes equations)

Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: A [Pa^(-n) s^(-1)] Glen rate factor (A = 3.5e-25 for -5 deg C isotherm); n = 3.0 flow law exponent; eps_dot_0 = 1.0e-10 s^(-1) regularization minimum strain rate
Stress_Regime_Validity: Non-Newtonian shear-thinning fluid; isotropic creep without fabric anisotropy
Boundary_Condition_Application: Evaluated cell-by-cell at numerical quadrature points
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Non-linear Picard linearization with Newton Gateaux derivative tangent operator

Mathematical_Formulation: eps_dot_e^2 = eps_xx^2 + eps_yy^2 + eps_xx * eps_yy + eps_xy^2
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: eps_xx = du/dx; eps_yy = dv/dy; eps_xy = 0.5 * (du/dy + dv/dx) [s^(-1)] horizontal strain rate components derived from velocity gradients
Stress_Regime_Validity: Assumes incompressibility (eps_zz = -(eps_xx + eps_yy)) and zero vertical shear strain rates in horizontal plane
Boundary_Condition_Application: Computed via central differences across cell faces
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Standard 2D symmetric strain rate tensor second invariant

Mathematical_Formulation: tau_b = - C_bed * (|u|^2 + u_0^2)^((m-1)/2) * u  [Grounded M=2];  tau_b = 0 [Floating M=3]
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: C_bed [Pa (m/s)^(-m)] basal traction coefficient; m = 1/3 (Weertman exponent); u_0 = 1.0e-04 m/yr regularization velocity to avoid infinite drag at stagnation
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid over hard bedrock or deforming saturated till; vanishes identically over subglacial ocean cavity
Boundary_Condition_Application: Applied at ice-bed interface z = b(x,y); scaled by sub-grid grounded area fraction f_gr in grounding cells
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Diagonal matrix block in Newton system: beta_b = C_bed * (|u|^2 + u_0^2)^((m-1)/2)

Mathematical_Formulation: u = 0 (No-slip Dirichlet) on nunataks / fjord bedrock walls Gamma_rock
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: Gamma_rock defines physical contact between ice margin and exposed bedrock / valley sidewalls (mask M=1 or boundary of Domain A)
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid where ice is frozen to or strongly restrained by lateral rock sidewalls in narrow alpine fjords
Boundary_Condition_Application: Enforced as strong Dirichlet condition on boundary nodes u|Gamma_rock = 0, v|Gamma_rock = 0
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Transverse shear stresses d/dy(2 H nu du/dy) develop naturally in adjacent cells without kappa_shape
Physical_Approximation_Classification: Physical Boundary Condition (Direct rock contact constraint)

Mathematical_Formulation: 2 H_ice nu (2 eps_nn + eps_tt) = 0.5 * rho_i g H_ice * (1 - (rho_i / rho_w) * (H_ice^2 / d^2))
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: eps_nn = normal strain rate; eps_tt = tangential strain rate; d = water depth [m]; rho_w = 1028 kg/m^3 seawater density; n = outward normal unit vector
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid at vertical calving margin terminating in open ocean bathymetry (water depth d = max(0, -b))
Boundary_Condition_Application: Applied as natural Neumann boundary condition on outer calving boundary Gamma_calv
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Hydrostatic seawater pressure integral balanced against internal lithostatic deviatoric stress
Physical_Approximation_Classification: Mathematical Derivation (Stress continuity across vertical ice-ocean interface; MacAyeal 1989)

Mathematical_Formulation: Coupled Grounded-Floating 2D SSA: sigma_back arises organically from floating shelf cavity stress solve
Symbol_Definitions_and_Units: If floating shelf is explicitly included in mesh, buttressing back-pressure is solved directly from 2D shelf shear pins. If shelf is truncated, impose tensor back-stress T_back = 0.5 rho_i g H^2 (1 - rho_i/rho_w) * theta_buttress * n
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid for unconfined calving fronts (theta=0), fully buttressed embayments (theta=1), or continuous shelf cavity solve
Boundary_Condition_Application: Applied across grounding line contour Gamma_GL (truncated model) or outer shelf calving front Gamma_shelf (coupled model)
Numerical_Discretization_Scheme: Coupled model eliminates empirical scalar parameter theta_buttress entirely
Physical_Approximation_Classification: Rigorous Physical Formulation (Coupled 2D shelf cavity continuum; Dupont & Alley 2005)
